meta.name: aspnet-core
meta.description: Build, review, refactor, or architect ASP.NET Core web applications using current official guidance for .NET web development. Use when working on Blazor Web Apps, Razor Pages, MVC, Minimal APIs, controller-based Web APIs, SignalR, gRPC, middleware, dependency injection, configuration, authentication, authorization, testing, performance, deployment, or ASP.NET Core upgrades.

copy.tagline: 构建、审查、重构或架构 ASP.NET Core 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 ASP.NET Core 开发 Web 应用或 API
copy.tagline_en: Build, review, refactor, or architect ASP.NET Core web applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing web applications or APIs with ASP.NET Core

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照微软官方指南帮助你构建、审查、重构或设计 ASP.NET Core 应用程序，包括 Blazor、Razor Pages、MVC、API、SignalR、gRPC 等。它会自动加载最少的参考文件，并优先使用最新的稳定版 .NET 和 ASP.NET Core。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 ASP.NET Core 项目（如新建、修改、升级或调试）时触发。特别适用于 Blazor、Razor Pages、MVC、API、SignalR、gRPC、中间件、依赖注入、配置、认证、测试、性能、部署或升级等场景。

say.text: 给这个 Minimal API 添加认证和授权。
把这个 .NET 6 的 MVC 项目升级到 .NET 10。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you build, review, refactor, or architect ASP.NET Core applications following official Microsoft guidance, covering Blazor, Razor Pages, MVC, APIs, SignalR, gRPC, and more. It loads minimal references and prefers the latest stable .NET and ASP.NET Core.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to work on an ASP.NET Core project (new, modify, upgrade, or debug). Especially for Blazor, Razor Pages, MVC, APIs, SignalR, gRPC, middleware, DI, configuration, auth, testing, performance, deployment, or upgrades.

say_en.text: Create a new Blazor Web App using ASP.NET Core 10.
Add authentication and authorization to this Minimal API.
